$comment: Single source of truth for the CI/local build. Each release lists the Spriggit YAML folders to deserialize and where the built .esp lands inside the release (FOMOD) tree. 'dest' paths must match the source= attributes in that release's fomod/ModuleConfig.xml (verified by build/build.ps1 -CheckFomod). Paths are repo-relative, and every patch's sources live under src/<PatchName>/. Optional per-release keys: 'scripts' {from,to} bulk-copies committed .pex; 'allowUnreferencedPlugins' silences the warning about a plugin the FOMOD never installs; 'fomod': false ships a plain archive with no installer - the right shape whenever the install has nothing to ask (a single .esp with no options, e.g. a replacement plugin), and build/staging/<name>/fomod/ must then not exist. 'files' [{from,to}] copies committed loose files (a file or a whole folder) into the archive, where to='' means the ARCHIVE ROOT - that is how a SPID _DISTR.ini ships, since SPID scans the Data folder non-recursively and never sees a config in a subfolder; combine it with 'plugins': [] for a config-only release. Optional per-plugin key: 'scripts' [{from,to}] copies individual .pex. Add releases with the /mod-new-plugin skill. An empty 'releases' array is valid - the build reports 'nothing to build' and succeeds, so the repo stays green before the first patch exists.

releases.$comment: ZEN edition: a SUPERSET of the release above, shipped under the SAME plugin filename so the two are mutually exclusive - install whichever matches the build of johnskyrim's mod you own. releases.$comment: Kata-related fixes. (1) The magic-vendor chest merge - all SEVEN contested chests (Funkentanz 102AD5, Torius 118050, Tarhutie 05BCD6, Milbert 127928, Maxus Tabbakus 022BF2, Barnabas 13824A, Ora Stonehand 0F9320) overridden with EGO SE - Leveling Redone's winning version plus every loser's re-appended stock - 214 entries: Kata's 15 staves, all 160 of Apocalypse's vendor tomes, xxOpenSpells' 4 books, the Emberlord patch's 5 entries. Regenerate with src/KataFixes/tools/01-merge-vendor-chests.py; audit for new ones with 00-audit-vendor-conflicts.py; MUST load after EGO SE - Leveling Redone.esp (mastered, so the engine enforces it). The same generator also adds CURATED stock no upstream mod put there: Apocalypse's 15 novice spell tomes at Tarhutie in Riverville, because Apocalypse hosts its novice tier at Milbert in Ark and Riverville is where a level-1 player actually is. (2) The recompiled Kata_Enderal_SpellPackageAddToLLists.pex (absorbed from the retired 'Zenderal - No Kata Debug Prompt' release): kills the debug prompt AND stops injecting the 29 spell lines duplicated between the two Kata packs; the mod folder MUST sort so it wins the loose-script file conflict with 'KataPUMB Magic Package'.
releases.name: Zenderal - Kata Fixes
